    • getDownstreamTimeout

      int getDownstreamTimeout(String certProfile, int bodyType)
      get the time in seconds after last response to downstream when an unfinished transaction should be forgotten
      Parameters:
      certProfile - certificate profile extracted from the CMP request header generalInfo field or null if no certificate profile was specified
      bodyType - request/response PKI Message Body type
      Returns:
      maximum transaction lifetime after last downstream interaction in seconds. the value 0 disables the timeout.
